title: The Seed inside the Apple Star
youtube_title: The Seed inside the Apple Star | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Showing someone how to look is a kind of gift.
summary: At a meadow fence and a bucket of water, Tala finds a star of seeds inside an apple cut across. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Tala shows Pilar how to look without disturbing it. Auntie Luz looks too, and they leave it where it is.
